title: XPLAT-010 Repository Bash Confinement Guard Result
description: data payload of the runner response for the new active-path-guard operation 'repo-bash-confinement'. Mirrors the XPLAT-009 zero-bash-guard result shape. status pass iff blocking_count == 0. Allowlisted vendored entries are surfaced under release_readiness_excluded and excluded from the positive Bash-free evidence set (FR-004).

classified_counts.description: Count of findings by classification (e.g. blocking_repo_bash, vendored_specify_helper).

source.description: Live repository-wide enumeration via the argv list ["git", "ls-files", "-z"] from the repo root (never a command string, never shell=True, never a fixed file list).

workflow_exclusion.description: The sanctioned Bash dispatch-glue boundary, applied as a post-enumeration Python filter.

release_readiness_excluded.description: True iff every allowlist entry carries release_readiness_excluded: true.

category.description: One of: script_file (.sh/.bash suffix or bash/POSIX-sh shebang), command_argv_subprocess / os_system / shell_true (Python AST), hooks_json_command, package_json_script.

classification.description: blocking_repo_bash for a violation; vendored_specify_helper for an allowlisted (release-readiness-excluded) vendored file.
